containerDefinitions.name: chatdebugmem
command:
import asyncio, time, os; from langgraph.checkpoint.postgres.aio import AsyncPostgresSaver
from src.services.agent_checkpointer_factory import langgraph_postgres_url
async def m():
  db_url = langgraph_postgres_url(os.getenv('DATABASE_URL'))
  print(f'URL prefix: {db_url[:40]}', flush=True)
  t0=time.time()
  print('TEST: AsyncPostgresSaver.from_conn_string + setup with timeout=30s', flush=True)
  try:
    async with asyncio.timeout(30):
      async with AsyncPostgresSaver.from_conn_string(db_url) as cp:
        print(f'  connected [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
        await cp.setup()
        print(f'  setup() done [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
  except asyncio.TimeoutError:
    print(f'  TIMEOUT after 30s — postgres saver hang [{time.time()-t0:.1f}s]', flush=True)
  except Exception as e:
    print(f'  EXCEPTION: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:300]}', flush=True)
asyncio.run(m())
